Indicator filter chip

Source: R/filter-indicator.R
cd_indicator_ui.Rd

A filter chip that chooses one indicator. A page puts cd_indicator_ui() in its filter bar or in a card, calls cd_indicator_server() in its server, and reads the chosen indicator from the reactive the server returns. The chip starts on its first choice.

Usage

cd_indicator_ui(
  id,
  i18n,
  label = NULL,
  tooltip = NULL,
  indicators = NULL,
  select_all = FALSE
)

cd_indicator_server(id)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

label

The translation key of the chip's label. NULL (the default) uses "title_global_indicator".

tooltip

The translation key of a hint shown with the chip, or NULL (the default) for none.

indicators

A character vector of indicator codes, the chip's choices. Without names, each indicator's label is the translation of opt_ followed by its code ("opt_penta3"). With names, the names are the translation keys of the labels. NULL (the default) offers every indicator, as get_all_indicators() lists them.

select_all

Logical. TRUE adds an "all" choice first, whose value is the empty string "". Default FALSE.

Value

cd_indicator_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags (the chip).

cd_indicator_server() returns a reactive holding the chosen indicator's code as a string. It holds "" when "all" is chosen, and NULL until the chip has reported its first value.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a page's ui
cd_indicator_ui(ns("indicator"), i18n, indicators = c("penta3", "measles1"), select_all = TRUE)

# in the page's server
indicator <- cd_indicator_server("indicator")
observe(print(indicator()))
} # }
